data.one_liner: Utilities and shaders for working with the FragmentProgram API in Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides utilities and available shaders like pixelation to make working with the FragmentProgram API easier in Flutter applications. Includes widgets like AnimatedSampler and helper interfaces for configuring uniforms.
use_when: You want to use custom fragment shaders with the AnimatedSampler widget
You want to include pre-built shaders like pixelation in your Flutter application
You need helper utilities to simplify constructing FragmentShader uniform data
avoid_when: You do not need to use fragment shaders or graphics processing
You are looking for state management or networking solutions
strengths: Simplifies working with the low-level FragmentProgram API
Includes pre-built utilities and shaders like pixelation
weaknesses: Limited documentation on all internals beyond the README and changelog
data.setup_notes: Requires declaring desired shaders in your pubspec.yaml under the flutter.shaders section.
